summary_en: Correction to 6 Jun 2026 buyback authorization: 130,000 shares (2.2% of 5,964,373 ex-treasury shares), ¥300M upper limit, open-market purchase on TSE, 8 Jun–30 Oct 2026. Original filing stated 4.2% (130,000÷5,901,082); corrected to 2.2% with updated ex-treasury base of 5,964,373 shares.
title_en: Notice of Partial Correction to Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Correction)
translation_en_brief: Temairazu Inc. issued a correction on 8 June 2026 to its 5 June 2026 treasury stock acquisition authorization. The original notice stated an upper limit of 130,000 shares representing 4.2% of shares outstanding; the corrected notice revises this to 2.2%. The revision stems from an error in the calculation of the ex-treasury share count: the original filing used 5,901,082 shares as the denominator, while the corrected figure is 5,964,373 shares as of 31 May 2026. All other material terms remain unchanged: acquisition of up to 130,000 common shares, ¥300 million upper limit on aggregate purchase price, open-market purchase method via the Tokyo Stock Exchange, and execution window of 8 June to 30 October 2026. The correction addresses the misstatement of the percentage of shares outstanding rather than any change to the program's size or terms.
